logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water distribution coefficients (logD7.4) of the complexes were measured using the shake-flask method.45 The absorption profile of the complex in each phase was measured by UV-VIS spectroscopy. The absorbance at 280 nm was recorded and used to determine the logD7.4 value using the formula: LogD7.4 = logAo - logAw Where Ao and Aw are the absorbance values of the complex in the n-octanol and water phases measured at λ = 280 nm, respectively.
